The Problem

AI is here. Structure is missing.

90% of companies are already experimenting with AI tools — but almost none have a method to preserve, scale, or measure the value.

Every employee has their own AI tricks — but nobody shares them. Knowledge stays in people's heads and disappears with the next job change.

Leadership has no overview: which AI tools are being used? For what tasks? With what risks?

AI projects start without a baseline. Eventually the CFO asks about ROI — and nobody can prove it.

AI knowledge in the team is unevenly distributed. A few enthusiasts drive forward, the majority waits.

Employees use external AI services with company data. IT and Legal don't know — until something goes wrong.

Training sessions are held once and fade away. Without a living system, AI knowledge doesn't grow.

What Adopty Does

Four pillars. One system.

01

AI Operating System

Structured adoption instead of chaos.

Adopty is the central platform where your company organises AI usage — from first experiment to company-wide rollout decision.

  • Create, version and approve workflows
  • Structured approval process for admins
  • Auto-import from any tool via webhook
02

Team Workflow Feed

The internal LinkedIn for AI workflows.

A social feed where employees share their best AI workflows, rate them, and adopt them in one click — knowledge that stays in the team.

  • Feed with ratings, comments & adoptions
  • Personalised recommendations by department
  • AI prompts copy-ready in every card
03

ROI Visibility

Finally, numbers for the CFO.

Adopty automatically calculates how many hours the team saves and what that means in euros — at department level, per tool, and for the whole company.

  • Live ROI dashboard with hours and € values
  • Department comparison and top performers
  • Export-ready for boards and leadership rounds
04

Governance & Control

Who uses what — and are they allowed to?

Shadow IT is the biggest unresolved risk in AI usage. Adopty gives IT and Legal the overview: which tools are in use, for which tasks, and with which data.

  • Tool governance with approval status
  • Security level definable per workflow
  • Knowledge Hub with internal AI guidelines

How it works

Live in three steps.

1

Set up your organisation — in 5 minutes

Invite your team, create departments, generate your first API key. No IT project. No weeks of onboarding. Ready to go immediately.

2

Capture and share first workflows

Employees log their best AI tip — manually, via the macOS menu bar widget, or automatically via n8n, Zapier or Make. The feed fills itself.

3

Measure adoption, scale knowledge

The dashboard shows in real time what works. Which workflows are being adopted? Where is the ROI? Who are the AI champions in the team?
